# Fixture manifest — packages/viewer/test/fixtures

Every asset these fixtures put on screen, where it comes from, and its licence.
The rule for H19 fixtures: every asset is CC0 or Pascal's own.

## h19-scene.json

Generated by `make-h19-scene.mjs` (deterministic: explicit ids, closed-form
positions, no randomness, no clock). Loaded by the capture harness through the
eco/1 bridge: `eco:hello` → `eco:load-scene` → `eco:load-site`.

| Asset | Where it lives | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| House: 8 walls, 4 rooms (zones), 1 floor slab, 3 doors, 3 windows, a gable roof, 1 straight stair | node data in `h19-scene.json` | this repository (`make-h19-scene.mjs`), built with core's own node parsers | ours — no geometry files; the editor builds the meshes |
| Terrain: 97 × 97 heightfield at 2.5 m (240 m square), flat pad within 45 m of the house | EcoSite in `h19-scene.json` | this repository — closed-form synthetic relief | ours — no survey, scan or purchased data |
| Site guides: a 84 m lot boundary and the house frame (massing outline) | EcoSite in `h19-scene.json` | this repository | ours |
| Site location `originLL` −119.1554, 34.4331 | EcoSite in `h19-scene.json` | plugin-eco's own default sun location (`eco-site-sun.ts`) | not a parcel; no owner data |
| 20 furniture items — sofa, coffee-table, livingroom-chair ×2, tv-stand, television, bookshelf, indoor-plant, dining-table, dining-chair ×4, fridge, double-bed, bedside-table ×2, dresser, toilet, bathroom-sink | models `apps/editor/public/items/<id>/model.glb` + `thumbnail.webp`, served by the editor under test | Pascal item library: catalog entries embedded by value from `packages/editor/src/components/ui/item-catalog/catalog-items.tsx` | Pascal's own — upstream `pascalorg/editor` ships these files in its repository, whose licence is MIT, © 2026 Pascal Group Inc. There is no per-asset licence file in `apps/editor/public/items`. |
| 30 trees — `tree` ×18, `fir-tree` ×12 (catalog, outdoor) | same folder | Pascal item library | Pascal's own, as above |

Item URLs are written as `{{origin}}/items/<id>/…` and filled in by the harness
with the page's own origin, so the fixture never fetches the remote bucket the
catalog normally points at. Whether the local copies are byte-identical to the
bucket copies is not verified; the fixture only ever uses the local ones.

## Considered and not used

| Asset | Why not |
|---|---|
| Eco trees (`plugin-eco` `eco-trees`, `ecoTrees` in `eco:load-scene`) and upstream `@pascal-app/plugin-trees` | Both generate trees with `@dgreenheck/ez-tree` (MIT, © 2024 Daniel Greenheck) and render its inlined textures. The bark texture's README cites Poly Haven `bark_brown_02` (CC0); the leaf images carry no recorded source or licence. Not provably CC0 or Pascal's own, so the fixture uses Pascal's catalog trees. |
